content: I am using Lean at Stellenbosch University as part of my studies at the Socio-Informatics department with a cosupervisor at Computer Science. But I am currently located in the UK
I also cosupervised a much smarter student at Computer Science, that completed their master's thesis using Lean @Keegan Perry: "Verified Derivative-Based Regular Expression Matching"
Would love to know about more people in Stellenbosch that are interested in Lean

Nice to meet you @awalterschulze . I'm into parsing programming languages, so I'm looking to prove logic equivalence between natural language (prompts) and Ai generated code. It's easy enough to do without Lean, and I don't know if CSLib is there yet but I'm interested in the Proof part of the equivalence. I got into ATP's while messing around with Zeta functions.
Can you give an example of a natural language prompt that is equivalent to AI generated code?
I got into Coq and then Lean while trying to prove correctness of a Brozozowski derivative algorithm for schema languages and I am still working on that :)
